@graph.name: EarlyJobs Bulk Hiring Checklist
@graph.description: Six-phase bulk hiring planning checklist covering requirements, sourcing, interviews, candidate tracking, joining coordination and drive review.

acceptedAnswer.text: Bulk hiring means filling many related vacancies in a defined window—often across shifts, plants or branches. It needs more coordination than single-role recruitment because approvals, interviews and joining move in parallel.

mainEntity.name: What should a bulk hiring plan include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cover approved vacancies, eligibility, sourcing channels, interview logistics, selection owners, budget and joining dates. The EarlyJobs checklist walks Indian employers through those steps in six phases before launch.

mainEntity.name: Can the checklist be used for factory recruitment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Adapt phases for production, packaging, warehouse or maintenance drives. Note shift coverage and plant-specific safety induction so interview panels and joining teams know floor expectations.

mainEntity.name: Is a bulk hiring checklist the same as a recruitment tracker?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The checklist plans what must happen; a tracker records individual candidate status. Use both—plan with the checklist, then monitor applications to joinings in your ATS or spreadsheet.

@graph.name: How to run a bulk hiring drive
@graph.description: Six-phase framework for planning and executing high-volume recruitment across vacancies, locations and shifts.

step.name: Define the hiring requirement
step.text: Confirm vacancies, job titles, locations, employment types, budgets, eligibility, shifts, joining dates and approval owners before sourcing begins.

step.name: Prepare candidate sourcing
step.text: Identify channels, prepare consistent job descriptions and align candidate communication for the roles and locations involved.

step.name: Plan interviews and assessments
step.text: Coordinate dates, venues, interviewer availability, assessments, documents, selection criteria and decision responsibilities.

step.name: Track candidate progress
step.text: Monitor Applications → Shortlisted → Interviewed → Selected → Offered → Joined with consistent stage definitions.

step.name: Coordinate joining
step.text: Confirm reporting date, location, documentation, compensation and working conditions — without replacing formal onboarding duties.

step.name: Review the hiring drive
step.text: Compare planned versus filled vacancies, attendance, offer-to-joining conversion, spend and remaining gaps.
